concepts.name: level
concepts.label: Level
concepts.meaning: How loud the sound comes out.

concepts.name: dynamics
concepts.label: Dynamics
concepts.meaning: How pressure turns into loudness: the curve from a light touch to a full press.

concepts.name: breath
concepts.label: Breath
concepts.meaning: The blowing pressure: how hard the player blows at a light and at a full touch.

concepts.name: air
concepts.label: Air noise
concepts.meaning: The audible air in the tone: breath hiss and turbulence.

concepts.name: response
concepts.label: Response
concepts.meaning: How quickly the sound follows the hand: smoothing and onset time.

concepts.name: threshold
concepts.label: Threshold
concepts.meaning: The pressure where a note starts.

concepts.name: release
concepts.label: Release
concepts.meaning: How long the sound rings after the key is released.

concepts.name: decay
concepts.label: Decay
concepts.meaning: How fast a struck or plucked sound dies away while held.

concepts.name: damper
concepts.label: Damper
concepts.meaning: The felt that stops the ringing.

concepts.name: strike
concepts.label: Strike
concepts.meaning: How hard the key is hit: the strike (velocity) and what it does to the start.

concepts.name: pressure
concepts.label: Pressure
concepts.meaning: How hard the key is pressed.

concepts.name: accent
concepts.label: Accent
concepts.meaning: The extra push at the start of a struck note, and how it settles.

concepts.name: tongue
concepts.label: Tongue
concepts.meaning: The "t" of a tongued start: the short noise burst before the tone.

concepts.name: slur
concepts.label: Slur
concepts.meaning: What happens when one note changes into the next without a new strike.

concepts.name: scoop
concepts.label: Scoop
concepts.meaning: The pitch sliding up into a note from below.

concepts.name: settle
concepts.label: Pitch settling
concepts.meaning: How fast the pitch finds its centre after a start or a change (the player's ear).

concepts.name: tuning
concepts.label: Tuning
concepts.meaning: The tuning: offsets in cents and the tuning system.

concepts.name: pitch
concepts.label: Pitch
concepts.meaning: A pitch offset or movement, up or down.

concepts.name: bend
concepts.label: Bend
concepts.meaning: Pitch bend: how far the pitch bends (the channel's or the note's pitch bend).

concepts.name: timbre
concepts.label: Timbre
concepts.meaning: The timbre control (MPE's CC 74, MIDI 2.0's per-note timbre), up or down from its centre: where the tone sits and how far it moves.

concepts.name: detune
concepts.label: Detune
concepts.meaning: Two voices slightly apart in pitch.

concepts.name: beat
concepts.label: Beat
concepts.meaning: Two reeds or modes a few cents apart, beating against each other.

concepts.name: vibrato
concepts.label: Vibrato
concepts.meaning: A regular wavering of the pitch.

concepts.name: tremolo
concepts.label: Tremolo
concepts.meaning: A regular wavering of the loudness.

concepts.name: flutter
concepts.label: Flutter
concepts.meaning: Flutter tongue: a fast rolled "r" in the air stream.

concepts.name: drift
concepts.label: Drift
concepts.meaning: A slow, irregular wander of pitch or tone, like a tape or an unsteady hand.

concepts.name: jitter
concepts.label: Jitter
concepts.meaning: A fast, fine roughness of the pitch.

concepts.name: life
concepts.label: Life
concepts.meaning: Micro-randomness: no two notes exactly alike.

concepts.name: shake
concepts.label: Shake
concepts.meaning: Motion: what a shake does (a host's motion input, its acceleration).

concepts.name: spin
concepts.label: Rotation
concepts.meaning: Motion: what a turn does (a host's motion input, its rotation).

concepts.name: growl
concepts.label: Growl
concepts.meaning: A throaty rasp when the note is pushed hard.

concepts.name: ensemble
concepts.label: Ensemble
concepts.meaning: More than one player on the note.

concepts.name: bow
concepts.label: Bow
concepts.meaning: The bow on the string: its force and speed.

concepts.name: bow-position
concepts.label: Bow position
concepts.meaning: Where the bow meets the string, from the fingerboard to the bridge.

concepts.name: pluck
concepts.label: Pluck
concepts.meaning: Pizzicato: the string plucked instead of bowed.

concepts.name: body
concepts.label: Body
concepts.meaning: The instrument's resonant body: its size and how much of it you hear.

concepts.name: pickup
concepts.label: Pickup
concepts.meaning: The electric pickup under the tine: its alignment and drive.

concepts.name: mallet
concepts.label: Mallet
concepts.meaning: The hammer or mallet: how hard its head is.

concepts.name: rub
concepts.label: Rub
concepts.meaning: A rubbed tone, like a finger on a wine glass.

concepts.name: tone
concepts.label: Brightness
concepts.meaning: How bright or dark the tone is.

concepts.name: resonance
concepts.label: Resonance
concepts.meaning: A resonant peak in the tone: where it sits, how strong and how narrow.

concepts.name: filter
concepts.label: Filter
concepts.meaning: The low-pass filter: its cutoff and how it opens.

concepts.name: drive
concepts.label: Drive
concepts.meaning: Saturation: the sound driven into a soft clip.

concepts.name: overtone
concepts.label: Overtone
concepts.meaning: The upper partials: the tone's harmonics and bell-like modes.

concepts.name: keytrack
concepts.label: Across the range
concepts.meaning: How something changes from the low notes to the high ones.

concepts.name: range
concepts.label: Range
concepts.meaning: The instrument's compass: its lowest note and where its registers lie.

concepts.name: instrument
concepts.label: Instrument
concepts.meaning: Which instrument the engine models.

concepts.name: saw
concepts.label: Saw
concepts.meaning: The sawtooth oscillator.

concepts.name: pulse
concepts.label: Pulse
concepts.meaning: The pulse oscillator and its width.

concepts.name: sub
concepts.label: Sub
concepts.meaning: The sub-oscillator an octave below.

concepts.name: sync
concepts.label: Sync
concepts.meaning: Oscillator sync: a second oscillator reset by the first.

concepts.name: reed
concepts.label: Reed
concepts.meaning: The reed: its opening, stiffness and resonance.

concepts.name: embouchure
concepts.label: Embouchure
concepts.meaning: The player's lips: how firm, how open, and how timbre moves them.

concepts.name: jet
concepts.label: Air jet
concepts.meaning: The flute's air jet meeting the edge of the embouchure hole.

concepts.name: bore
concepts.label: Bore
concepts.meaning: The instrument's tube: its size, losses and resonance.

concepts.name: tone-holes
concepts.label: Tone holes
concepts.meaning: The open tone holes: the cutoff that shapes the wind tone.

concepts.name: flare
concepts.label: Bell
concepts.meaning: The brass bell: its flare and reflection.

concepts.name: brassiness
concepts.label: Brassiness
concepts.meaning: The brassy blare: the wave steepening as the note gets loud.

concepts.name: mute
concepts.label: Mute
concepts.meaning: A mute in the bell: how deep, and its character.

concepts.name: mouthpiece
concepts.label: Mouthpiece
concepts.meaning: The mouthpiece cup and its resonance.

concepts.name: radiate
concepts.label: Radiation
concepts.meaning: How the sound leaves the instrument into the room.

concepts.name: bellows
concepts.label: Bellows
concepts.meaning: The accordion's bellows: shared air, its curve and reversals.

concepts.name: pallet
concepts.label: Pallet
concepts.meaning: The key's valve: how it opens, throttles and closes the air to the reed.

concepts.name: reed-bank
concepts.label: Reed banks
concepts.meaning: The registers: which reed banks sound (16', 8', 4').

concepts.name: chamber
concepts.label: Tone chamber
concepts.meaning: The cassotto: a chamber that mellows the reeds routed through it.

concepts.name: midi
concepts.label: MIDI
concepts.meaning: MIDI out: mode, channel, controllers and timing.

concepts.name: voices
concepts.label: Voices
concepts.meaning: How many notes can sound at once.

concepts.name: mono
concepts.label: Mono
concepts.meaning: One voice: every held key plays the same voice, sliding or re-attacking.

concepts.name: engine
concepts.label: Engine
concepts.meaning: Which sound engine plays.

concepts.name: preset
concepts.label: Preset
concepts.meaning: A stored set of settings or a stored sound.

concepts.name: flip
concepts.label: Flip
concepts.meaning: The layout turned 180 degrees.

concepts.name: swap
concepts.label: Swap
concepts.meaning: Two keys change places.

concepts.name: keys
concepts.label: Function keys
concepts.meaning: A host's function keys.

concepts.name: led
concepts.label: Colour
concepts.meaning: A light's colour.

concepts.name: jack
concepts.label: Pedal jack
concepts.meaning: The pedal or MIDI jack: what is plugged in.

concepts.name: power
concepts.label: Restart
concepts.meaning: Restart.

concepts.name: tag
concepts.label: Name
concepts.meaning: A name for a preset or tuning.
